overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by approving its June 10, 2020 minutes on December 15, 2021, outside the timely-approval window, but ordered no further action because the Board had already approved them before the complaint was filed.

allegations.summary: A complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve the minutes of its June 10, 2020 meeting, approving them only on December 15, 2021.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find, and the Board acknowledges, that the minutes of the June 10, 2020, meeting were not timely approved, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.
